specs.Camera-wiki: Lanjian Saomiao She Ying Yi 950 SM
specs.英文简介: The Lanjian Saomiao She Ying Yi 950 SM is a panoramic camera for images 90x300mm imagesThe notes at Westlicht (cited below) state that the camera makes images 90x300 or 90x160mm; presumably the two image-widths correspond to the two shutter speeds; the photo of the control for setting the speed suggests this.
